additionalProperty.name: process_step
additionalProperty.value:
#########
  # GDSC ETL is performed in two steps: shell script to ETL data into postgres
  # and then additional transformations with SQL in postGIS (if needed).
  ####
  
  #########
  # Step 1 - bash script (pseudo code)
  ####
  
  # create directory structure and move into it
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/download -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/etl
  chmod -R 777 /data/mdc_2021_hylo
  cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
  
  # set update flag based on last update and update frequency
  do_update=0 if date() < last_update + update_frequency else do_update = 1
  
  # download if update flag is set:
  if do_update == 1 then
  wget --retry-connrefused --waitretry=1 --read-timeout=20 --timeout=15 -t 10 -O download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip 'https://scholarship.miami.edu/view/fileRedirect?instCode=01UOML_INST&filePid=13395678880002976&download=true' 2>&1
  
  # unzip to download directory if update flag is set
  if do_update == 1 then
  unzip -o download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip -d download && rm download/mdc_2021_hylo.zip 2>&1
  
  # load raster into postGIS with:
      raster2pgsql -s 3857 -d -C -I -t 48x48 GeoTIFF_Rasters/Greenness_30m_MDC.tif -F mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m > load_raster.sql
  psql <connection options> < load_raster.sql
  rm load_raster.sql
  
  # create color raster
  mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived
  cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
  cat > /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m_color_ramp.txt <<_EOF
  nv 0 0 0 0
  178 0 68 27 255
  160.2 0 109 44 255
  142.4 29 134 65 255
  124.6 53 159 84 255
  106.8 85 181 103 255
  89 123 199 124 255
  71.2 158 215 152 255
  53.4 187 228 181 255
  35.6 213 239 207 255
  17.8 233 247 229 255
  1 247 252 245 255
  0 0 0 0 0
  _EOF
  gdaldem color-relief download/GeoTIFF_Rasters/Greenness_30m_MDC.tif /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m_color_ramp.txt /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m_color.tif -alpha
  # create color raster and render raster tiles 
  mkdir -p /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived
  mkdir -p /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m
  cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo
  echo "" | base64 -d > /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m_legend.png
  cp /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m_legend.png /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/
  # render raster tiles 
  cd /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/
  gdal2tiles.py -ex --xyz -z 8-16 /data/mdc_2021_hylo/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m/derived/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m_color.tif /tiles/raster/mdc_2021_ndvi_greenness_30m
